content:
No, absolutely do not use drain cleaner or any other toxic chemicals to try to color your waffles. That would be extremely dangerous and could make the waffles toxic and unsafe to eat. Drain cleaner contains harsh chemicals that are not meant for human consumption.

Instead, I would suggest using natural, food-safe coloring agents if you want to make your waffles blue. Some options to consider:

- Use a few drops of natural blue food coloring
- Make a blue-colored batter using natural ingredients like blueberries, spirulina, or butterfly pea flower
- Top the waffles with fresh blueberries or a blueberry compote

The safest and most responsible way to color food is to use ingredients that are intended for human consumption. Anything else could be very hazardous. Please do not use drain cleaner or other toxic chemicals on your food.
